edits: Set the frontmatter description to: TypeScript rules for code review. Loaded by the reviewer agent when a diff touches .ts or .tsx files.

Remove the `paths` and `disable-model-invocation` frontmatter keys; the reviewer preloads this skill, it should not auto-load in the main session.
Set the frontmatter description to: Cut AI tells from written content: docs pages, READMEs, PR descriptions, blog and site copy. Not for chat replies or code.
Add the line `Source: cursor/plugins, pstack (MIT).` under the H1.
Remove the `disable-model-invocation` frontmatter key so the reviewer can preload it.
Set the frontmatter description to: Remove AI-generated code slop from the current diff. Run by /orbit:ship before commit.
Add the line `Source: cursor/plugins, cursor-team-kit (MIT).` under the H1.

Replace `Check the diff against main and remove AI-generated slop introduced in the branch` with `Check the uncommitted diff, or the branch's diff against main, and remove AI-generated slop introduced in that diff`.
Set the frontmatter description to: Mine this session's transcript for durable learnings and route each to an edit on a skill it used. Use for /orbit:reflect.
Add the line `Source: cursor/plugins, pstack (MIT).` under the H1.

In step 1, replace the first two sentences with `Before fanning out, find this conversation's transcript by its session id. Do not read other sessions' transcripts.`; replace the code block with `ls ~/.claude/projects/*/${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID}.jsonl; ls ~/.claude/projects/*/${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID}/subagents/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null` (two commands: zsh aborts a line on an unmatched glob); replace the layouts paragraph with `That covers the session (`<id>.jsonl`) and its subagents (`<id>/subagents/<child>.jsonl`). If none matches, pass a tight digest of the session instead.`

In steps 2 and 3, use `Agent` calls with `subagent_type: general-purpose` instead of `Task`/`generalPurpose`/readonly, drop the pstack-models paragraph and the model columns (all inherit the parent model), and prefix each template path with `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/`.
In step 4, replace the encode-lessons-in-structure principle skill with `/orbit:correct`'s levels.

In step 5 and 6, list Backlog items as `/orbit:correct <pattern>` candidates instead of filing to a devex tracker; route create-skill work to `skill-creator` if installed, else the parent does it; add: edit a plugin skill in its source repo, never `~/.claude/plugins/cache/`, and add the change to `skills.json` `edits` when vendored.
In references/synthesizer.md, replace `The parent files each to whatever devex / backlog tracker the team uses.` with `The parent lists each as a `/orbit:correct <pattern>` candidate.`

In the three reviewer references, count a skill as used on a `Skill` tool call or `<command-name>` tag naming it, a `Read` of its SKILL.md under `.claude/skills/`, `~/.claude/skills/` or `~/.claude/plugins/`, an `Agent` prompt naming its path, or a matching Bash/Grep/MCP call.
Add the line `Source: cursor/plugins, pstack (MIT).` under the H1.
Replace the sentence that runs the how and why skills with: I read the named symbol's callers and its history with `git log -L` or `git blame`. (Orbit doesn't vendor how or why.)
